literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在致死攻击研究中,在三个小鼠实验之一中,与单独使用 A(H5) 疫苗接种 相比,在 A(H5) 疫苗接种 之前进行季节性 疫苗 启动与改善结果相关,但在其他两个小鼠实验或雪貂中没有观察到这种效果。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2731495]

疫苗接种 平均覆盖率从 34.5% 增加到 47.6%,但在许多国家仍低于欧盟 75% 的目标。疫苗接种 覆盖率提高 1 个百分点与每 100,000 名 55 岁以上成年人的全因死亡减少 14.9 人相关(95% CI:-22.8 至 -7.1),每 100,000 人全因伤残调整生命年减少 328.1 人(95% CI:-480.4 至 -175.8),以及 6.3每 100,000 人中的 LRTI DALY 较少(95% CI:-10.6 至 -2.0)。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129163]
接种疫苗接种后7天,患者出现了口腔溃疡性病变以及前胸壁、会阴区和阴茎体的多个水疱样病变。在病变中检测到HSV-1 DNA,但未检测到HSV-2及其他性传播病原体。 [10.1080/21645515.2026.2735737]
结果显示,VirPLM显著优于代表性方法,并在交叉验证和回顾性时间分割评估中均保持稳健性能。 [10.1093/bioinformatics/btag692]
流感变异株的适应度得分与其在下一季节中实际观察到的频率之间存在强正相关。 [10.64898/2026.09.15.751745]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: In lethal challenge studies, seasonal vaccine priming before A(H5) vaccination was associated with improved outcomes compared with A(H5) vaccination alone in one of three mouse experiments, but this effect was not observed in the other two mouse experiments or in ferrets. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2731495]
Mean vaccination coverage increased from 34.5% to 47.6% but remained below the EU target of 75% in many countries. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129163]

Seven days after vaccination, the patient developed oral ulcerative lesions and multiple vesicular eruptions involving the anterior chest wall, pubic region, and penile shaft. HSV-1 DNA was detected in the lesions, but HSV-2 and other sexually transmitted pathogens were not detected. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2735737]

The results show that VirPLM significantly outperforms representative methods and maintains robust performance under both cross-validation and retrospective time-split evaluations. [10.1093/bioinformatics/btag692]
The fitness scores of influenza variants present strong positive correlation with their actual observed frequencies in the next seasons. [10.64898/2026.09.15.751745]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
在致死攻击研究中,在三个小鼠实验之一中,与单独使用 A(H5) 疫苗接种 相比,在 A(H5) 疫苗接种 之前进行季节性 疫苗 启动与改善结果相关,但在其他两个小鼠实验或雪貂中没有观察到这种效果。

疫苗接种 平均覆盖率从 34.5% 增加到 47.6%,但在许多国家仍低于欧盟 75% 的目标。疫苗接种 覆盖率提高 1 个百分点与每 100,000 名 55 岁以上成年人的全因死亡减少 14.9 人相关(95% CI:-22.8 至 -7.1),每 100,000 人全因伤残调整生命年减少 328.1 人(95% CI:-480.4 至 -175.8),以及 6.3每 100,000 人中的 LRTI DALY 较少(95% CI:-10.6 至 -2.0)。

papers.title: Seasonal influenza vaccination coverage and population health burden in Europe during the 2019/2020 and 2021/2022 influenza seasons: an ecological panel analysis using principal-component-adjusted multivariable regression.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Few studies have examined whether country-level seasonal influenza vaccination coverage is associated with population health burden. We assessed the associations of influenza vaccination coverage with all-cause mortality and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) across countries participating in the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE). METHODS: We conducted an ecological panel analysis using SHARE Waves 8 (2019-2020) and 9 (2021-2022) across participating EU/EEA countries, Switzerland, and Israel. Survey-weighted vaccination coverage and structural indicators were derived among adults aged ≥55 years. All-cause mortality, all-cause DALYs, lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) DALYs, and chronic disease-specific DALYs were obtained from the Global Burden of Disease database for the same age group. Principal component analysis (PCA) was performed on the pooled country-season dataset to summarize correlated structural covariates. Associations were estimated using linear mixed-effects models with country-specific random intercepts. RESULTS: Mean vaccination coverage increased from 34.5% to 47.6% but remained below the EU target of 75% in many countries. After adjustment for period and PCA-derived covariates, a 1-percentage-point higher vaccination coverage was associated with 14.9 fewer all-cause deaths per 100,000 adults aged ≥55 years (95% CI: -22.8 to -7.1), 328.1 fewer all-cause DALYs per 100,000 (95% CI: -480.4 to -175.8), and 6.3 fewer LRTI DALYs per 100,000 (95% CI: -10.6 to -2.0). Subgroup-specific vaccination coverage was also inversely associated with diabetes DALYs (-12.1; 95% CI: -20.3 to -3.8). CONCLUSIONS: In this two-period ecological analysis, higher country-level influenza vaccination coverage was inversely associated with mortality and DALY burden among adults aged ≥55 years. These findings should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating population-level associations rather than causal effects.

papers.title_zh: 季节性流感 疫苗接种 2019/2020 和 2021/2022 流感季节欧洲的覆盖率和人口健康负担:使用主成分调整多变量回归进行生态面板分析。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Few studies have examined whether country-level seasonal influenza vaccination coverage is associated with population health burden. We assessed the associations of influenza vaccination coverage with all-cause mortality and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) across countries participating in the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE). METHODS: We conducted an ecological panel analysis using SHARE Waves 8 (2019-2020) and 9 (2021-2022) across participating EU/EEA countries, Switzerland, and Israel. Survey-weighted vaccination coverage and structural indicators were derived among adults aged ≥55 years. All-cause mortality, all-cause DALYs, lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) DALYs, and chronic disease-specific DALYs were obtained from the Global Burden of Disease database for the same age group. Principal component analysis (PCA) was performed on the pooled country-season dataset to summarize correlated structural covariates. Associations were estimated using linear mixed-effects models with country-specific random intercepts. RESULTS: Mean vaccination coverage increased from 34.5% to 47.6% but remained below the EU target of 75% in many countries. After adjustment for period and PCA-derived covariates, a 1-percentage-point higher vaccination coverage was associated with 14.9 fewer all-cause deaths per 100,000 adults aged ≥55 years (95% CI: -22.8 to -7.1), 328.1 fewer all-cause DALYs per 100,000 (95% CI: -480.4 to -175.8), and 6.3 fewer LRTI DALYs per 100,000 (95% CI: -10.6 to -2.0). Subgroup-specific vaccination coverage was also inversely associated with diabetes DALYs (-12.1; 95% CI: -20.3 to -3.8). CONCLUSIONS: In this two-period ecological analysis, higher country-level influenza vaccination coverage was inversely associated with mortality and DALY burden among adults aged ≥55 years. These findings should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating population-level associations rather than causal effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:很少有研究探讨国家层面的 季节性流感 疫苗接种 覆盖率是否与人口健康负担相关。我们评估了参与欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查 (SHARE) 的国家中流感 疫苗接种 覆盖率与全因 死亡率 和伤残调整生命年 (DALY) 的关联。方法:我们使用 SHARE Waves 8(2019-2020)和 9(2021-2022)对参与的欧盟/欧洲经济区国家、瑞士和以色列进行了生态面板分析。调查加权的 疫苗接种 覆盖率和结构指标是在 55 岁以上的成年人中得出的。全因 死亡率、全因 DALY、下呼吸道感染 (LRTI) DALY 和慢性病特异性 DALY 均从全球疾病负担数据库中获得相同年龄组的数据。对汇总的乡村季节数据集进行主成分分析 (PCA),以总结相关的结构协变量。使用具有特定国家随机截距的线性混合效应模型来估计关联性。结果:疫苗接种 平均覆盖率从 34.5% 增加到 47.6%,但在许多国家仍低于欧盟 75% 的目标。对周期和 PCA 衍生的协变量进行调整后,疫苗接种 覆盖率提高 1 个百分点与每 100,000 名 55 岁以上成年人的全因死亡减少 14.9 例相关(95% CI:-22.8 至 -7.1),每 100,000 名成年人全因 DALY 减少 328.1 例(95% CI:-480.4 至 -7.1) -175.8),每 100,000 人的 LRTI DALY 减少 6.3 个(95% CI:-10.6 至 -2.0)。亚组特异性 疫苗接种 覆盖率也与糖尿病 DALY 呈负相关(-12.1;95% CI:-20.3 至 -3.8)。结论:在这项两阶段生态分析中,国家级流感 疫苗接种 覆盖率较高与 55 岁以上成年人的 死亡率 和 DALY 负担呈负相关。这些发现应被解释为假设生成的人群水平关联,而不是因果效应。

papers.title: Limited added benefit of seasonal influenza vaccination before A(H5) vaccination in mice and ferrets challenged with A(H5N1).
papers.abstract: Limited A(H5)-specific vaccine supply is expected early in a potential A(H5N1) pandemic, raising the question of whether licensed seasonal influenza vaccines could enhance protection when administered before A(H5) vaccination. We evaluated this strategy in mouse and ferret models using clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses. Seasonal influenza vaccination induced antibodies to seasonal haemagglutinins but did not induce detectable antibodies against A(H5) and did not consistently enhance A(H5)-directed antibody responses after A(H5) vaccination. In lethal challenge studies, seasonal vaccine priming before A(H5) vaccination was associated with improved outcomes compared with A(H5) vaccination alone in one of three mouse experiments, but this effect was not observed in the other two mouse experiments or in ferrets. These findings suggest that seasonal influenza vaccine priming provides limited added benefit to A(H5) vaccine-mediated protection against A(H5N1) under the conditions tested.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到动物模型使用和实验结果不一致的限制,这可能会影响对人群的普遍性。

papers.title: Multifocal mucocutaneous herpes simplex virus type 1 infection temporally associated with seasonal influenza vaccination in a young adult without a known immunocompromising condition: A case report.
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza vaccination is widely implemented and generally safe; however, rare immunological adverse events have been reported. We describe a case of multifocal mucocutaneous Herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) infection temporally associated with seasonal influenza vaccination in a 28-year-old man without a known immunocompromising condition. Seven days after vaccination, he developed oral ulcerative lesions and multiple vesicular eruptions involving the anterior chest wall, pubic region, and penile shaft. A multiplex polymerase chain reaction assay performed on specimens obtained from clinically apparent lesions detected HSV-1 DNA, whereas HSV-2 and other sexually transmitted pathogens included in the assay were not detected. Intravenous acyclovir was administered, resulting in complete clinical resolution. Although causality cannot be established, the close temporal relationship between influenza vaccination and the onset of HSV-1 infection is noteworthy, while alternative explanations cannot be excluded. This case highlights the importance of considering HSV infection in the differential diagnosis of multifocal mucocutaneous lesions occurring after influenza vaccination without implying a causal relationship.

papers.title: Seasonal influenza vaccine strain selection by quantifying viral fitness
papers.abstract: The long-standing challenge of seasonal influenza vaccines providing poor protection is attributed to the rapid and continuous evolution of the virus. In theory, the recommendation of vaccine strain is to predict the dominant strain with best fitness in the upcoming season. Here, we develop FutureFlu, a biologically-grounded framework that quantifies the fitness score of influenza variants in upcoming seasons, by integrating metrics on three levels: molecular genetic divergence, individual immune escape, and population-scale transmission dynamics. The fitness scores of influenza variants present strong positive correlation with their actual observed frequencies in the next seasons. Validation across 24 seasons of three influenza subtypes shows FutureFlu recommends antigenically matched vaccine strains more frequently than annual recommendations, particularly for challenging subtypes: 83.3% versus 45.8% seasons for A/H3N2, and 75.0% versus 33.3% seasons for B/Victoria. Furthermore, FutureFlu significantly outperforms the currently used methods in vaccine strain selection whether or not there is available antigenic data from hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assay, which provides a valuable supplement for WHO vaccine recommendation. To support global public health implementation, an open online platform (futureflu.com.cn) has been established to offer real-time viral fitness predictions and vaccine recommendations.

papers.abstract_zh: 长期存在的 季节性流感 疫苗 提供的保护不足的挑战归因于病毒的快速且持续的 进化。理论上,疫苗 菌株的推荐是预测在即将到来的季节中适应性最佳的主导菌株。在此,我们开发 FutureFlu,一个生物学基础的框架,通过整合三个层面的指标——分子遗传分化、个体免疫逃逸以及人口规模 传播 动态——来量化即将到来季节中流感变体的适应度得分。流感变体的适应度得分与其在下一个季节中实际观察到的频率呈强烈正相关。验证在 24 个季节的三种流感亚型中显示,FutureFlu 更频繁地推荐抗原配体匹配的 疫苗 菌株,而非年度推荐,尤其是在具有挑战性的亚型:A/H3N2 为 83.3% 与 45.8% 的季节,B/Victoria 为 75.0% 与 33.3% 的季节。此外,FutureFlu 在 疫苗 菌株选择上显著优于目前使用的方法,无论是否有来自血凝抑制(HI)试验的抗原数据,这为 WHO 疫苗 推荐提供了有价值的补充。为支持全球公共卫生实施,已建立开放的在线平台 (futureflu.com.cn) 以提供实时病毒适应度预测和 疫苗 推荐。

papers.title: VirPLM: Antigenic prediction of influenza A/H3N2 viruses with a fine-tuned protein language model.
papers.abstract: Abstract Motivation Human influenza A/H3N2 viruses undergo rapid antigenic evolution primarily driven by the hemagglutinin subunit 1 (HA1). Within HA1, amino acid substitutions under immune pressure cause antigenic drift, necessitating frequent updates to vaccine strains. While hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assays remain the gold standard for assessing antigenic relationships, their labor-intensive and low-throughput nature limits scalability. Fortunately, the rapid accumulation of HA1 sequences enables sequence-based antigenic prediction, yet effectively extracting informative representations from these viral sequences remains challenging. Results In this study, we present VirPLM, a two-stage framework that adapts the ESM-2 protein language model to H3N2 HA1 sequences for antigenic prediction. VirPLM significantly outperforms representative methods and maintains robust performance under both cross-validation and retrospective time-split evaluations. Moreover, VirPLM identifies highly critical sites enriched in known regions related to antigenic evolution. In the season-specific coverage analysis, VirPLM-prioritized strains achieve higher estimated coverage rates than the corresponding historical strains recommended by the World Health Organization in most evaluated seasons, suggesting that VirPLM can provide complementary sequence-based evidence for candidate strain prioritization. Availability and Implementation The source code is available at https://github.com/xingyili/VirPLM, and the version used in this study is archived in Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21650323). Supplementary Information Supplementary information is available at Bioinformatics online.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 动机 人类甲型H3N2流感病毒经历快速的抗原漂移 进化,主要由血凝素亚基1(HA1)驱动。在HA1内部,免疫压力下的氨基酸置换导致抗原漂移,因而需要频繁更新疫苗株系。虽然血凝抑制(HI)实验仍是评估抗原关系的金标准,但其劳动强度大、通量低的特性限制了可扩展性。幸运的是,HA1序列的快速积累使基于序列的抗原预测成为可能,但如何有效提取这些病毒序列中的信息表征仍具挑战性。结果 本研究提出了VirPLM,这是一种两阶段框架,将ESM-2蛋白语言模型适配到H3N2 HA1序列用于抗原预测。VirPLM显著优于代表性方法,并在交叉验证和回顾性时间分割评估中均保持稳健性能。此外,VirPLM识别出高度关键位点,这些位点富集于已知的与抗原 进化 相关的区域。在季节特异性覆盖率分析中,VirPLM优先选择的株系在大多数评估季节中实现了高于世界卫生组织推荐的相应历史株系的估计覆盖率,表明VirPLM可为候选株系优先级提供互补的基于序列的证据。可用性与实现 源代码可在 https://github.com/xingyili/VirPLM 获取,本文使用的版本已存档于Zenodo(DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21650323)。补充信息 补充信息可在 Bioinformatics 在线获取。

papers.title: Bovine mammary tissues are susceptible to infection by viruses bearing panzootic H5N1 influenza A virus glycoproteins
papers.abstract: The emergence of the panzootic clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in 2020 marked a major expansion in the host range of influenza A viruses (IAVs), raising concerns about further cross-species transmission events and zoonotic spillover. The introduction of 2.3.4.4b viruses into US dairy herds has resulted in widespread circulation, accompanied by reduced milk yield, mastitis and high viral loads in milk. Notably, virus circulation in dairy cattle represents a novel route for mammalian adaptation and transmission that has already led to more than 40 human cases in the USA since 2024. As haemagglutinin (HA) is the primary determinant of viral host range and tissue tropism, we investigated whether viruses containing the glycoproteins of avian H5N1 subclade 2.3.4.4b viruses could infect mammary tissue from Aberdeen Angus, Holstein Friesian and Limousin cattle. Using mammary gland explants, we inoculated tissues with attenuated reassortant viruses expressing the HA and neuraminidase (NA) of three 2.3.4.4b viruses that predated the emergence of H5N1 in the US cattle: A/chicken/England/053052/2021 (AIV07), A/chicken/Scotland/054477/2021 (AIV09) and A/chicken/England/085598/2022 (AIV48). Detection of viral NP antigen by immunohistochemistry in explants from both the teat and gland cistern for all three breeds following inoculation with AIV09 and AIV48 indicates that mammary tissue from each of the three tested cattle breeds is susceptible to infection by viruses bearing H5N1 glycoproteins. Lectin staining showed expression of both α2,3- and α2,6-linked sialic acids in the mammary tissue of all donors, indicating that all three breeds have the potential to support infection with both avian- and mammalian-adapted IAVs. Together, these findings demonstrate that the mammary glands from both beef and dairy cattle breeds are susceptible to infection with viruses bearing avian-origin H5N1 glycoproteins and suggest that bovine mammary tissue may provide an environment in which diverse IAVs could co-infect the same tissue. This possibility underscores the need for further investigation and the inclusion of both beef and dairy cattle in ongoing H5N1 surveillance and risk-assessment frameworks.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings demonstrate that bovine mammary tissue is susceptible to infection by viruses bearing H5N1 glycoproteins and may provide an environment for co‐infection of diverse influenza A viruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the need to include both beef and dairy cattle in H5N1 surveillance and risk‐assessment frameworks, as bovine mammary glands could serve as a reservoir for influenza A virus evolution.

analysis.summary_en: The study investigated whether bovine mammary tissue could be infected by influenza A viruses bearing H5N1 glycoproteins, a concern heightened by the 2020 emergence of the panzootic clade 2.3.4.4b. Using explants from three cattle breeds, researchers inoculated tissues with reassortant viruses expressing HA and NA from pre‐US‐cattle H5N1 strains. Infection was confirmed by immunohistochemistry detecting viral NP antigen in both teat and gland cistern tissues, and lectin staining showed that all breeds expressed both avian‐ and mammalian‐linked sialic acids, the receptors for influenza A virus. These results demonstrate that bovine mammary tissue is susceptible to H5N1‐bearing viruses and could support co‐infection of diverse influenza A strains. Consequently, the findings highlight the importance of incorporating beef and dairy cattle into ongoing H5N1 surveillance and risk‐assessment efforts.

papers.summary_zh: 2020年泛疫源性2.3.4.4b亚群高致病性H5N1禽流感病毒的出现标志着A型流感病毒(IAVs)的感染范围发生了重大扩展,引发了对进一步跨物种传播和人兽共患病的担忧。2.3.4.4b病毒在美国奶牛群中的引入导致了广泛传播,伴随产奶量下降、乳腺炎和牛奶中高病毒载量。值得注意的是,奶牛中的病毒传播代表了一种新的哺乳动物适应和跨物种传播途径,自2024年以来已在美国导致超过40例人类病例。由于血凝素(HA)是决定病毒感染范围和组织嗜性的主要因素,我们研究了携带禽流感H5N1亚群2.3.4.4b病毒包膜蛋白的病毒是否能够感染安格斯牛、荷斯坦弗里斯兰牛和利木赞牛的乳腺组织。我们使用乳腺组织器官培养,将组织接种于表达三种在H5N1在美国奶牛出现前的2.3.4.4b病毒HA和神经氨酸酶(NA)的减毒重组病毒:A/chicken/England/053052/2021(AIV07)、A/chicken/Scotland/054477/2021(AIV09)和A/chicken/England/085598/2022(AIV48)。接种AIV09和AIV48后,通过免疫组化检测所有三种牛种的乳头和乳腺囊组织中的病毒NP抗原,结果表明这三种牛种的乳腺组织均易感于携带H5N1包膜蛋白的病毒感染。通过凝集素染色发现所有供体的乳腺组织均表达α2,3-和α2,6-连接的唾液酸,表明这三种牛种都有可能支持禽源和哺乳动物适应型IAVs的感染。这些发现表明,肉牛和奶牛的乳腺腺体均易感于携带禽源H5N1包膜蛋白的病毒感染,并提示牛乳腺组织可能成为多种IAVs共同感染的环境。这种可能性强调了进一步研究的必要性,并应将肉牛和奶牛纳入正在进行的H5N1监测和风险评估框架中。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究者使用了来自安格斯牛、荷斯坦弗里斯兰牛和利木赞牛的乳腺组织器官培养,并将这些组织接种于表达三种在H5N1在美国奶牛出现前的2.3.4.4b病毒HA和NA的减毒重组病毒。
analysis_zh.methods: 乳腺组织器官培养被接种重组病毒,通过免疫组化检测病毒NP抗原,并通过凝集素染色检测α2,3-和α2,6-连接的唾液酸。
analysis_zh.main_results: 接种AIV09和AIV48后,免疫组化检测发现所有三种牛种的乳头和乳腺囊组织中均存在病毒NP抗原,凝集素染色显示所有供体组织均表达α2,3-和α2,6-连接的唾液酸。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,牛乳腺组织易感于携带H5N1包膜蛋白的病毒感染,并可能成为多种A型流感病毒共同感染的环境。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调了将肉牛和奶牛纳入H5N1监测和风险评估框架的必要性,因为牛乳腺腺体可能成为A型流感病毒的储存宿主。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告局限性。

papers.title: Ubiquitination in influenza a virus-host interactions
papers.abstract: As a key pathogen responsible for zoonotic respiratory tract infections, Influenza A virus (IAV) is capable of undergoing antigenic drift and antigenic shift. These two mechanisms result in annual global epidemics caused by IAV, with occasional pandemics. Ubiquitination is an important post-translational modification that maintains cellular homeostasis and internal balance by participating in various biological processes within cells, and it is also a crucial host antiviral defense mechanism. Mutation of gene sites in IAV-encoded proteins is a crucial mechanism for viruses to evolve and adjust to the host environment. This article systematically reviews the mechanisms of interaction between key amino acid residues of IAV-encoded proteins undergoing ubiquitination and host proteins, as well as the effects of experimental mutations, aiming to deeply elucidate the interaction between influenza virus and the host.

papers.abstract_original: As a key pathogen responsible for zoonotic respiratory tract infections, Influenza A virus (IAV) is capable of undergoing antigenic drift and antigenic shift. These two mechanisms result in annual global epidemics caused by IAV, with occasional pandemics. Ubiquitination is an important post-translational modification that maintains cellular homeostasis and internal balance by participating in various biological processes within cells, and it is also a crucial host antiviral defense mechanism. Mutation of gene sites in IAV-encoded proteins is a crucial mechanism for viruses to evolve and adjust to the host environment. This article systematically reviews the mechanisms of interaction between key amino acid residues of IAV-encoded proteins undergoing ubiquitination and host proteins, as well as the effects of experimental mutations, aiming to deeply elucidate the interaction between influenza virus and the host.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the interaction mechanisms between key amino acid residues of Influenza A virus (IAV)-encoded proteins undergoing ubiquitination and host proteins, as well as the effects of experimental mutations. The central question is to deeply elucidate the interaction between influenza virus and the host.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the mechanisms of interaction between IAV-encoded proteins and host proteins related to ubiquitination. It includes experimental mutations and their effects, aiming to understand the molecular interactions involved in IAV-host interactions.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Ubiquitination is a crucial host antiviral defense mechanism that plays a significant role in maintaining cellular homeostasis and internal balance. The review highlights the importance of ubiquitination in the interaction between IAV and host proteins, particularly through the modification of key amino acid residues in IAV-encoded proteins.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that mutation of gene sites in IAV-encoded proteins is a crucial mechanism for viral evolution and adaptation to the host environment. However, the evidence is limited in terms of specific mechanisms and their implications, indicating a need for further research.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that understanding the role of ubiquitination in IAV-host interactions could lead to new strategies for antiviral interventions. It emphasizes the need for more detailed studies on the molecular mechanisms of ubiquitination and its impact on viral evolution and host defense.

The study highlights the importance of ubiquitination as a host defense mechanism and identifies gaps in understanding specific molecular interactions. The findings suggest potential avenues for research and antiviral strategies targeting these interactions.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,IAV编码蛋白的基因位点泛素化是病毒进化和适应宿主环境的关键机制。然而,关于具体机制及其影响的证据仍有限,表明需要进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,理解泛素化在IAV-宿主相互作用中的作用可能有助于开发新的抗病毒药物干预策略。它强调需要更详细地研究泛素化的分子机制及其对病毒进化和防御的影响。}}.{

papers.abstract: Autophagy-associated protein 13 (ATG13) plays a pivotal role in regulating the assembly of the autophagy initiation complex. However, the function and mechanism of action of ATG13 during influenza virus infection remain incompletely understood. This study elucidates that ATG13 restricts influenza A virus (IAV) replication while potentiating the activation of the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. Mechanistically, coimmunoprecipitation assays revealed that ATG13 interacts with MAVS and recruits the E3 ubiquitin ligase ASB1 to catalyze K63-linked polyubiquitination at the K348 residue, thereby amplifying the downstream antiviral signalling cascade. Furthermore, through dual-luciferase reporter assays and pharmacological inhibition of autophagy, we confirmed that this novel immunomodulatory function of ATG13 is independent of the canonical autophagy pathway. The present study identifies ATG13 as a novel host restriction factor against IAV and reveals a nonautophagic role for ATG13 in antiviral innate immunity.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the function and mechanism of action of ATG13 during influenza virus infection, as its role in regulating the autophagy initiation complex is well established, but its specific involvement in influenza virus replication remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study focused on influenza A virus (IAV) and influenza B virus, examining their interactions with ATG13 in the context of antiviral innate immunity. The research was conducted using molecular and cellular approaches to elucidate the mechanism of ATG13's immunomodulatory function.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and molecular analyses, and further in vivo studies are needed to confirm the broader implications of ATG13's role in antiviral immunity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of clinical or epidemiological data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of ATG13 in influenza virus infection, revealing its function as a host restriction factor against influenza A virus (IAV). The research demonstrates that ATG13 interacts with MAVS and recruits ASB1 to catalyze K63-linked polyubiquitination, thereby enhancing antiviral signaling. The findings highlight a nonautophagic mechanism of ATG13 in innate immunity, offering new insights into host-virus interactions. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, and further research is needed to validate these results in vivo. The evidence is moderate, as it does not include clinical or epidemiological data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨ATG13在流感病毒感染中的功能及作用机制,因为其在调控自噬起始复合物中的作用已得到证实,但其在流感病毒复制中的具体参与仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于流感A病毒(IAV)和流感B病毒,探讨它们在抗病毒药物固有免疫背景下的与ATG13的相互作用。研究采用分子和细胞方法,以阐明ATG13的免疫调节功能机制。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用共免疫沉淀实验来探讨ATG13与MAVS之间的相互作用,并结合自噬药理学抑制实验,确认ATG13的功能独立于经典的自噬通路。
elements_zh.main_results: 共免疫沉淀实验显示,ATG13与MAVS相互作用,并招募E3泛素连接酶ASB1在K348位点催化K63连接的多泛素化,从而放大下游抗病毒药物信号级联反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定ATG13为一种新型宿主限制因子,对抗IAV,并揭示了ATG13在抗病毒药物固有免疫中的非自噬性作用,为了解其在流感病毒感染期间的功能提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解限制流感A病毒复制的宿主因素,并可能为针对I型干扰素通路的新治疗策略的开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和分子分析,需要进一步的体内研究来确认ATG13在抗病毒药物免疫中的更广泛意义。由于缺乏临床或流行病学数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 自噬相关蛋白13(ATG13)在调节自噬起始复合体的组装中发挥关键作用。然而,ATG13在流感病毒感染期间的功能及作用机制仍未完全阐明。本研究阐明,ATG13限制甲型流感病毒(IAV)复制,同时增强I型干扰素(IFN-I)通路的激活。在机制上,共免疫沉淀实验显示,ATG13与MAVS相互作用并招募E3泛素连接酶ASB1,在K348残基处催化K63链型多泛素化,从而放大下游抗病毒药物信号级联。此外,通过双荧光素酶报告基因实验和自噬的药理抑制,我们确认ATG13的这一新型免疫调节功能独立于经典自噬途径。本研究将ATG13确定为针对IAV的全新宿主限制因子,并揭示ATG13在抗病毒药物先天免疫中的非自噬作用。

papers.title: Immunogenetic determinants of influenza B virus susceptibility and vaccine response: current evidence, gaps, and future directions
papers.abstract: Influenza B virus (IBV) remains an important but comparatively underexamined contributor to seasonal influenza burden, particularly in children, adolescents, and older adults. Although IBV lacks the broad animal reservoir and pandemic potential of influenza A virus, its epidemiology, evolutionary dynamics, and contribution to variable vaccine effectiveness remain clinically and biologically important. Recent surveillance has further changed the field: no confirmed naturally circulating B/Yamagata-lineage viruses have been detected since March 2020, and current influenza B activity is overwhelmingly attributable to B/Victoria-lineage viruses. An important but still insufficiently developed dimension of IBV biology is immunogenetics. Variation in antigen presentation, innate sensing pathways, interferon responsiveness, and host dependency or restriction factors may contribute to heterogeneity in susceptibility, disease severity, cross-lineage immunity, and vaccine responsiveness. However, the strength of evidence varies across these domains, and much of the proposed framework still relies on inference from broader influenza literature rather than direct IBV-specific human data. In this review, we evaluate current evidence for immunogenetic determinants of IBV susceptibility and vaccine response, while distinguishing direct IBV findings from conclusions extrapolated from influenza A virus or general antiviral immunology. Available evidence identifies antigenic match, antigenic drift, age, exposure history, and baseline immunity as the best-supported non-genetic determinants of vaccine performance, whereas IBV-specific host-genetic predictors of susceptibility and vaccine response remain incompletely defined. We further highlight the major evidence gaps that limit predictive models of IBV immune control and vaccine performance, and outline priorities for future research, including integrated studies linking host genotype, immune phenotyping, and lineage-resolved virologic outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses the underexamined role of influenza B virus (IBV) in seasonal influenza burden, particularly in children, adolescents, and older adults. It evaluates current evidence on immunogenetic determinants of IBV susceptibility and vaccine response, distinguishing findings specific to IBV from those extrapolated from influenza A virus or general antiviral immunology. The study highlights that while antigenic match, antigenic drift, age, exposure history, and baseline immunity are well-supported non-genetic factors influencing vaccine performance, IBV-specific host-genetic predictors remain poorly defined. Recent surveillance indicates that B/Victoria-lineage viruses dominate current influenza B activity, with no confirmed B/Yamagata-lineage viruses since March 2020. The authors emphasize the need for integrated studies linking host genotype, immune phenotyping, and lineage-resolved virologic outcomes to improve predictive models for IBV immune control and vaccine effectiveness. However, the evidence is limited by reliance on broader influenza literature rather than direct IBV-specific human data, which affects the strength of conclusions.

papers.title_zh: 流感B病毒易感性及疫苗免疫应答的免疫遗传学决定因素:现有证据、研究空白与未来方向
papers.source_body_en: Influenza B virus (IBV) remains an important but comparatively underexamined contributor to seasonal influenza burden, particularly in children, adolescents, and older adults. Although IBV lacks the broad animal reservoir and pandemic potential of influenza A virus, its epidemiology, evolutionary dynamics, and contribution to variable vaccine effectiveness remain clinically and biologically important. Recent surveillance has further changed the field: no confirmed naturally circulating B/Yamagata-lineage viruses have been detected since March 2020, and current influenza B activity is overwhelmingly attributable to B/Victoria-lineage viruses. An important but still insufficiently developed dimension of IBV biology is immunogenetics. Variation in antigen presentation, innate sensing pathways, interferon responsiveness, and host dependency or restriction factors may contribute to heterogeneity in susceptibility, disease severity, cross-lineage immunity, and vaccine responsiveness. However, the strength of evidence varies across these domains, and much of the proposed framework still relies on inference from broader influenza literature rather than direct IBV-specific human data. In this review, we evaluate current evidence for immunogenetic determinants of IBV susceptibility and vaccine response, while distinguishing direct IBV findings from conclusions extrapolated from influenza A virus or general antiviral immunology. Available evidence identifies antigenic match, antigenic drift, age, exposure history, and baseline immunity as the best-supported non-genetic determinants of vaccine performance, whereas IBV-specific host-genetic predictors of susceptibility and vaccine response remain incompletely defined. We further highlight the major evidence gaps that limit predictive models of IBV immune control and vaccine performance, and outline priorities for future research, including integrated studies linking host genotype, immune phenotyping, and lineage-resolved virologic outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 流感B病毒(IBV)仍然是儿童、青少年和老年人中季节性流感负担的重要但相对研究较少的贡献因素。尽管IBV缺乏流感A病毒所具有的广泛动物储存宿主和大流行潜力,但其流行病学、进化动态以及对可变疫苗效果的贡献在临床和生物学上仍具有重要意义。近期的监测进一步改变了这一领域:自2020年3月以来,未检测到任何确认的自然循环B/Yamagata谱系病毒,当前流感B病毒活动几乎全部归因于B/Victoria谱系病毒。IBV生物学的一个重要但尚未充分发展的维度是免疫遗传学。抗原呈递、先天感知通路、干扰素反应性以及宿主依赖或限制因素的变异可能影响易感性、疾病严重程度、跨谱系免疫以及疫苗免疫应答的异质性。然而,这些领域的证据强度存在差异,许多提出的框架仍依赖于更广泛的流感文献推断,而非直接的IBV特异性人类数据。在本综述中,我们评估了当前关于IBV易感性及疫苗免疫应答的免疫遗传学决定因素的证据,同时区分了直接针对IBV的研究结果与从流感A病毒或一般抗病毒药物免疫学中推导出的结论。现有证据表明,抗原匹配、抗原漂移、年龄、暴露史和基础免疫力是目前支持最强的非遗传决定因素,而IBV特异性的宿主遗传预测因子对易感性和疫苗免疫应答的影响仍不完全明确。我们进一步强调了限制IBV免疫控制和疫苗免疫应答预测模型的主要证据空白,并提出了未来研究的优先事项,包括将宿主基因型、免疫表型和谱系解析的病毒学结果相联系的整合研究。

papers.title: Streamlined CRISPR-based assays for detection and subtyping of H5 and H7 avian influenza
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) are zoonotic pathogens that pose an increasing global threat due to their potential for significant economic losses in agriculture, and the risk of a pandemic should human-to-human transmission occur. In light of this, we need rapid, sensitive, and specific tests to detect and differentiate circulating AIVs. Current AIV diagnostic methods require specialized laboratory equipment, limiting their use in the field and in low-resource settings. Here, we develop three CRISPR-based Streamlined Highlighting of Infections to Navigate Epidemics (SHINE) assays that address these limitations. We designed, optimized, and validated a SHINE assay for H5 AIV, achieving 100% specificity when tested on seasonal-influenza-positive clinical samples, and a limit of detection of 121.7 copies/μL. We also developed SHINE assays targeting the 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) and Eurasian H7 lineages. Together, these SHINE assays offer a promising platform for AIV diagnosis and surveillance, particularly outside laboratory settings.

The research was motivated by the need for rapid, sensitive, and specific diagnostic tools for AIVs, which are zoonotic pathogens with significant economic and pandemic risks. The SHINE assays were designed, optimized, and validated using seasonal-influenza-positive clinical samples, achieving 100% specificity and a limit of detection of 121.7 copies/μL for the H5 assay. The assays offer a promising platform for AIV diagnosis and surveillance, particularly in field and low-resource settings. The study does not report limitations, but the evidence is based on a single assay validation and does not include broader testing or comparison with other diagnostic methods. The findings suggest that these assays could improve surveillance and early detection of AIVs, contributing to public health preparedness.

papers.title: Association of hematological and inflammatory markers with influenza A virus infection in children: a retrospective study of 1,379 antigen-confirmed cases
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Influenza A virus (IAV) infection remains a significant cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide. Rapid antigen detection tests are widely used but have limited sensitivity. This study evaluated complete blood count (CBC)-derived parameters and composite inflammatory indices associated with IAV infection in children and examined age-dependent variations. Methods A retrospective study of 1,379 pediatric patients (685 IAV-positive, 694 IAV-negative) with influenza-like illness admitted to People’s Hospital of Deyang City who underwent both rapid antigen detection tests and CBC testing. Patients were stratified into five age groups. Logistic regression, ROC analysis, and formal age-interaction testing were performed. papers.title: TRIM62 facilitates influenza A virus entry by regulating WASH-dependent endosomal trafficking
papers.abstract: Abstract Endocytosis enables efficient cargo uptake while restricting uncontrolled cellular entry, yet how this balance is enforced during endocytic uptake remains poorly understood. Using influenza A virus (IAV) as a model cargo, we reveal a previously unrecognized role for the pentameric WASH complex (WASH) as a regulatory hub that integrates both permissive and inhibitory functions to control viral endocytosis. While the WASH subunits WASH1, CCDC53, SWIP, and Strumpellin collectively promote IAV entry, the FAM21 subunit acts antagonistically. Our data suggest that FAM21-mediated association of WASH with the retromer subunit VPS35 restrains the pro-endocytic activity of WASH, thereby limiting viral uptake. This inhibitory FAM21-VPS35 axis is counteracted by the E3 ubiquitin ligase TRIM62, which maintains WASH in a retromer-free, endocytically competent state that facilitates viral internalization. Beyond IAV, the WASH1 subunit and VPS35 also exhibit opposing roles during cholera toxin B uptake, suggesting a broader function in lipid raft-mediated endocytosis. Together, our findings establish WASH as a key determinant of IAV endocytosis, with TRIM62 modulating retromer-mediated restriction to facilitate productive viral entry.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how the balance between permissive and inhibitory functions during endocytic uptake is enforced, particularly in the context of influenza A virus entry.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used influenza A virus (IAV) as a model cargo to investigate the role of the WASH complex in viral endocytosis, focusing on the interactions between WASH subunits and the retromer complex.
analysis.methods: The researchers examined the functional roles of WASH subunits, particularly FAM21 and WASH1, in relation to the retromer subunit VPS35, and explored how TRIM62 modulates these interactions to influence IAV entry.
analysis.main_results: The findings indicate that FAM21-mediated association of WASH with VPS35 restricts WASH's pro-endocytic activity, thereby limiting viral uptake, while TRIM62 counteracts this by maintaining WASH in a retromer-free state that promotes viral internalization.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that TRIM62 plays a critical role in modulating the inhibitory effects of FAM21-VPS35 on WASH, thereby facilitating productive IAV entry, which represents a novel mechanism in viral endocytosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform the development of targeted therapies or interventions that disrupt WASH-mediated viral entry, potentially improving strategies for combating seasonal influenza.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and cell-based experiments, and the evidence is based on functional assays and molecular interactions, which may not fully capture in vivo complexities, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the WASH complex in influenza A virus (IAV) entry, revealing that FAM21-mediated interactions with VPS35 inhibit WASH's pro-endocytic activity, while TRIM62 counteracts this to facilitate viral internalization. The research highlights a novel mechanism involving TRIM62 in modulating WASH function during IAV uptake, with implications for understanding viral entry dynamics. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, which may not fully reflect in vivo conditions, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment. The findings contribute to the broader understanding of lipid raft-mediated endocytosis and may inform future therapeutic strategies targeting viral entry pathways.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在理解在内吞摄取过程中如何维持促进和抑制功能之间的平衡,特别是在流感A病毒进入的背景下。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用流感A病毒(IAV)作为模型货物,以研究WASH复合物在病毒内吞作用中的作用,重点研究WASH亚基与VPS35亚基之间的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员研究了WASH亚基,特别是FAM21和WASH1的功能作用,特别是在与VPS35亚基的相互作用中,探讨了TRIM62如何调节这些相互作用以影响IAV进入。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,FAM21介导的WASH与VPS35的结合限制了WASH的促内吞作用,从而限制了病毒摄取,而TRIM62通过维持WASH在无VPS35的内吞作用状态来促进病毒内化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,TRIM62在调节FAM21-VPS35对WASH的抑制作用中起着关键作用,从而促进IAV的高效进入,这代表了内吞作用中的一种新型机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发针对WASH介导的病毒进入的靶向疗法或干预措施提供信息,可能有助于改进对抗季节性流感的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和细胞实验,证据基于功能测定和分子相互作用,可能无法完全捕捉体内复杂性,导致中等程度的信心评估。

papers.title: ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES TOWARDS COVID-19 AND SEASONAL FLU VACCINES AND VACCINATION IN THE GENERAL POPULATION AND AMONG MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS
papers.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to the development of several types of vaccines, among which messenger RNA (mRNA)-based vaccines have represented a significant breakthrough. This study aimed to evaluate attitudes towards COVID-19 and seasonal influenza vaccination among the general population and individuals with a medical background. A questionnaire was developed to collect sociodemographic data, personal health information, vaccination status, and information on participants’ attitudes towards and knowledge of vaccines. The profile of the typical participant was an employed woman with tertiary education, living with another person in an urban area and reporting generally good health. The typical participant had received at least two doses of the Sputnik V vaccine. Participants generally expressed favourable attitudes towards regular COVID-19 vaccination. The results showed no apparent differences between participants with and without a medical background regarding vaccine choice, the decision to receive a third dose, or seasonal influenza vaccination. Similarly, no apparent differences were observed in attitudes towards the AstraZeneca vaccine or mandatory COVID-19 vaccination between respondents with and without a medical background.

papers.title: Modeling the interferon response to avian influenza
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, such as H5N1, cause severe disease in humans and pose a persistent pandemic threat, yet the mechanism by which the type I interferon response shapes their within-host dynamics remains unclear. Here we fit three ordinary differential equation models, in which interferon reduces the viral infection rate, reduces viral production, or drives cells into a refractory state, to paired viral load and IFN- \(\alpha \) 2 time courses from human nasal and tracheal respiratory epithelium infected with a seasonal H3N2 strain and with 2005 and 2022 clades of H5N1. Although the refractory-state model attains the lowest residual error in most conditions, the small-sample-corrected Akaike information criterion does not justify its additional parameter, and the two alternative mechanisms, reduction of infection rate or reduction of production rate, describe the data comparably well. While a structural identifiability analysis suggests all parameters are globally identifiable when both viral titer and interferon are observed, with only ten observations per condition the data cannot single out one mechanism of interferon action. The bootstrapped parameter distributions are largely similar across strains when compared with a Mann-Whitney U-test, differing mainly in the rate of interferon clearance, with only modest differences between the nasal and tracheal epithelium. These results quantify the interferon response to avian influenza in human respiratory tissue and underscore the need for more frequently sampled data to resolve the dominant mechanism of interferon action in vivo.

papers.title_zh: 禽流感病毒干扰素反应建模
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, such as H5N1, cause severe disease in humans and pose a persistent pandemic threat, yet the mechanism by which the type I interferon response shapes their within-host dynamics remains unclear. Here we fit three ordinary differential equation models, in which interferon reduces the viral infection rate, reduces viral production, or drives cells into a refractory state, to paired viral load and IFN- \(\alpha \) 2 time courses from human nasal and tracheal respiratory epithelium infected with a seasonal H3N2 strain and with 2005 and 2022 clades of H5N1. Although the refractory-state model attains the lowest residual error in most conditions, the small-sample-corrected Akaike information criterion does not justify its additional parameter, and the two alternative mechanisms, reduction of infection rate or reduction of production rate, describe the data comparably well. While a structural identifiability analysis suggests all parameters are globally identifiable when both viral titer and interferon are observed, with only ten observations per condition the data cannot single out one mechanism of interferon action. The bootstrapped parameter distributions are largely similar across strains when compared with a Mann-Whitney U-test, differing mainly in the rate of interferon clearance, with only modest differences between the nasal and tracheal epithelium. These results quantify the interferon response to avian influenza in human respiratory tissue and underscore the need for more frequently sampled data to resolve the dominant mechanism of interferon action in vivo.
papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感病毒,如H5N1,会导致人类严重疾病并构成持续的流行病威胁,但干扰素I型反应如何塑造其在宿主内的动态机制仍不清楚。在这里,我们拟合了三种常微分方程模型,其中干扰素降低病毒感染率、降低病毒产生率,或促使细胞进入非易感状态,以分析人类鼻和气管呼吸道上皮组织感染季节性H3N2毒株以及2005年和2022年H5N1毒株分支时的病毒载量和IFN-\(\alpha\) 2时间进程。尽管非易感状态模型在大多数情况下具有最低的残差误差,但经过小样本校正的Akaike信息准则并不支持其额外参数,而两种替代机制,即降低感染率或降低产生率,都能很好地描述数据。虽然结构可识别性分析表明,当同时观察到病毒滴度和干扰素时,所有参数都是全局可识别的,但仅用每种情况下的十个观察值,数据无法区分干扰素作用的单一机制。通过Mann-Whitney U检验比较不同毒株的参数分布,发现它们在大多数方面相似,主要差异在于干扰素清除速率,鼻和气管上皮组织之间的差异则较为有限。这些结果量化了干扰素在人类呼吸道组织对禽流感的反应,并强调了需要更频繁采样的数据以确定干扰素在体内的主要作用机制。

papers.title: Innovation, development, and licensure of improved influenza vaccines: the way forward.
papers.abstract: The Influenza Vaccines R&D Roadmap (IVR) Initiative was established to: (1) highlight the public health need for improved vaccines against pandemic and seasonal influenza; (2) raise the visibility of opportunities to create highly effective and rapidly produceable influenza vaccines; and (3) facilitate sustained investment in vaccine R&D. Incremental progress has been made in achieving many of the activities outlined in the IVR. However, without significant improvements in vaccine performance (efficacy, durability, ability to block virus transmission) and production (manufacturing speed, scale-up capacity, adaptability), we risk having to fight the next influenza pandemic with last century's technology. This report reviews remaining barriers to advanced development of vaccines for global use against seasonal and pandemic influenza and summarizes key priorities and activities for moving the influenza vaccine R&D enterprise forward.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on seasonal influenza viruses, specifically human influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria, as well as the historical B/Yamagata lineage. The central question is about the development and licensure of improved influenza vaccines to address public health needs for pandemic and seasonal influenza.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a general overview of the progress made in achieving the objectives outlined in the Influenza Vaccines R&D Roadmap (IVR) Initiative. It does not report specific databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or a meta-analysis process.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that without significant improvements in vaccine performance (efficacy, durability, ability to block virus transmission) and production (manufacturing speed, scale-up capacity, adaptability), we risk having to fight the next influenza pandemic with last century's technology.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the remaining barriers to advanced vaccine development for global use against seasonal and pandemic influenza, but it does not specify conflicting findings or evidence gaps in detail.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The report reviews the remaining barriers to advanced development of vaccines for global use against seasonal and pandemic influenza and summarizes key priorities and activities for moving the influenza vaccine R&D enterprise forward.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the development and licensure of improved influenza vaccines to address the public health need for pandemic and seasonal influenza. It highlights the progress made in achieving the objectives of the Influenza Vaccines R&D Roadmap (IVR) Initiative and underscores the importance of improving vaccine performance and production. The review identifies key barriers to vaccine development and outlines priorities for advancing the influenza vaccine R&D enterprise. Without significant improvements, the next influenza pandemic may still be fought with outdated technology.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 报告回顾了疫苗继续在全球范围内应对季节性和大流行性流感所面临的剩余障碍,并总结了推动流感疫苗 R&D企业前进的关键优先事项和活动。

papers.abstract_zh: 流感疫苗研发路线图(IVR)倡议的设立旨在:(1) 强调针对大流行和季节性流感的改进疫苗的公共卫生需求;(2) 提高创建高效且可快速生产的流感疫苗的机会可见度;(3) 促进对疫苗研发的持续投资。已在实现IVR概述的众多活动方面取得了渐进性进展。然而,如果疫苗的性能(有效性、耐久性、阻断病毒传播的能力)和生产(制造速度、规模化能力、适应性)没有显著提升,我们将面临只能用上个世纪的技术来应对下一次流感大流行的风险。本报告审查了全球使用季节性和大流行流感时疫苗的高级开发仍存的障碍,并概述了推动流感疫苗研发事业前进的关键优先事项和活动。

papers.title: Immunogenicity and safety of high-dose versus standard-dose quadrivalent inactivated influenza vaccine in patients living with HIV: a randomized controlled trial.
papers.abstract: Influenza remains a major cause of morbidity in people living with HIV (PLWH), and despite recommendations for annual vaccination with the standard-dose (SD) quadrivalent inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV4), immune responses are often suboptimal in this population. To address this gap, we conducted a randomized, single-blinded, controlled trial to compare the immunogenicity and safety of the high-dose (HD) IIV4 (60 μg, Efluelda, Sanofi) with the SD IIV4 (15 μg, Vaxigrip Tetra, Sanofi). Vaccinations were administered between August and December 2023, and seroprotection (SP) was defined as a hemagglutination-inhibition antibody titer ≥1:40 at one month post-vaccination. Adverse events (AEs) were actively monitored. Of 110 participants enrolled, 103 were included in the per-protocol analysis (52 HD; 51 SD). The mean age was 49.6 years, 63.1% were male, and the median CD4 count was 555 cells/mm 3 . Most participants were virologically suppressed (93.2%), and more than half were receiving integrase inhibitor–based antiretroviral regimens (57.3%). Overall, 50.5% of participants achieved SP to all four vaccine strains. The HD group demonstrated significantly higher overall SP compared with the SD group (61.5% vs. In strain-specific analyses, a significantly higher seroprotection rate was observed for A/H3N2 (76.9% vs. In multivariable logistic regression, receipt of HD IIV4 (OR 2.7, 95% CI 1.9–6.1, p = 0.02) and female sex (OR 2.5, 95% CI 1.1–5.9, p = 0.04) were independently associated with SP against all strains. AEs were reported in 55.8% of HD and 58.8% of SD recipients ( p = 0.75), most commonly local reactions, with no severe vaccine-related events observed. In conclusion, HD IIV4 enhanced immunogenicity against the vaccine A/H3N2 strain compared with SD IIV4, without increasing the risk of adverse events compared to SD IIV4. These findings suggest that HD IIV4 may enhance immunogenicity in PLWH and warrant further investigation in studies evaluating clinical effectiveness (TCTR20230501002).

papers.title_zh: 高剂量与标准剂量四价灭活流感疫苗疫苗在艾滋病毒感染者中的免疫原性和安全性:随机对照试验。
papers.source_body_en: Influenza remains a major cause of morbidity in people living with HIV (PLWH), and despite recommendations for annual vaccination with the standard-dose (SD) quadrivalent inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV4), immune responses are often suboptimal in this population. To address this gap, we conducted a randomized, single-blinded, controlled trial to compare the immunogenicity and safety of the high-dose (HD) IIV4 (60 μg, Efluelda, Sanofi) with the SD IIV4 (15 μg, Vaxigrip Tetra, Sanofi). Vaccinations were administered between August and December 2023, and seroprotection (SP) was defined as a hemagglutination-inhibition antibody titer ≥1:40 at one month post-vaccination. Adverse events (AEs) were actively monitored. Of 110 participants enrolled, 103 were included in the per-protocol analysis (52 HD; 51 SD). The mean age was 49.6 years, 63.1% were male, and the median CD4 count was 555 cells/mm 3 . Most participants were virologically suppressed (93.2%), and more than half were receiving integrase inhibitor–based antiretroviral regimens (57.3%). Overall, 50.5% of participants achieved SP to all four vaccine strains. The HD group demonstrated significantly higher overall SP compared with the SD group (61.5% vs. In strain-specific analyses, a significantly higher seroprotection rate was observed for A/H3N2 (76.9% vs. In multivariable logistic regression, receipt of HD IIV4 (OR 2.7, 95% CI 1.9–6.1, p = 0.02) and female sex (OR 2.5, 95% CI 1.1–5.9, p = 0.04) were independently associated with SP against all strains. AEs were reported in 55.8% of HD and 58.8% of SD recipients ( p = 0.75), most commonly local reactions, with no severe vaccine-related events observed. In conclusion, HD IIV4 enhanced immunogenicity against the vaccine A/H3N2 strain compared with SD IIV4, without increasing the risk of adverse events compared to SD IIV4. These findings suggest that HD IIV4 may enhance immunogenicity in PLWH and warrant further investigation in studies evaluating clinical effectiveness (TCTR20230501002).

papers.title: UNIVERSAL EPIDEMIC SCALING: INFLUENZA AND COVID-19
papers.abstract: Conventional compartmental models may become difficult to parameterize over multi-wave epidemic horizons when susceptibility and transmission conditions change between successive epidemic regimes. This study introduces a reduced macroscopic framework that changes the scale of epidemic description from individual-level transmission structure to effective population-level dynamics. Epidemic waves are formulated as transport processes governed by deterministic boundaries, mass balance, and a small set of effective macroscopic parameters. The susceptible population is represented by a dynamic Effective Susceptible Pool that can be re-initialized at transitions between biologically distinct epidemic regimes, while transmission resistance and external control measures are incorporated at the macroscopic level. The resulting equations admit a dimensionless similarity representation and closed-form analytical solutions, enabling analytical estimation of epidemic trajectories and peak healthcare demand without computationally intensive numerical simulation. The framework is evaluated using comparative time-series data for SARS-CoV-2 and seasonal influenza A within the geographically and demographically consistent setting of Rhode Island. Despite their different biological and immunological regimes, the analyzed trajectories exhibit a common reduced asymptotic scaling form. The results support the use of a macroscopic, scale-reduced representation for cross-calibration of heterogeneous surveillance signals and analytical assessment of healthcare-system demand. Further validation across pathogens, populations, and open-system settings is required.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更灵活的模型提供信息,用于预测流行病轨迹和医疗需求,这对于公共卫生准备和资源分配至关重要。

papers.title: Case Report: Coinfection of influenza A and Chlamydia psittaci pneumonia
papers.abstract: The coinfection of influenza A and Chlamydia psittaci pneumoniae is rarely described in China. However, the clinical features of these diseases pose a significant diagnostic challenge. Therefore, it is necessary to report and review such a potentially fatal case. We report an 89-year-old male patient requiring admission to the intensive care unit with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, shock and MODS. He presented with fever, fatigue, anorexia and dyspnea. The patient exhibited severe hypoxemia, shock, hepatic dysfunction (elevated liver enzymes and serum bilirubin), acute kidney injury and a SOFA score of 17. Mechanical ventilation (MV) and venous-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) were established for respiratory support. The initial diagnosis focused on influenza A for his positive influenza A nucleic acid. However, the patient's imaging presentation was not coupled with viral pneumonia, which raised suspicion for other pathogens. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) detected coinfection of C psittaci , influenza A H3N2 virus, and Klebsiella pneumoniae in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid. Concurrent targeted NGS (tNGS) detected C. Omadacycline and baloxavir marboxil were prescribed. The patient's condition improved, and he was successfully weaned from VV-ECMO and MV. He was discharged and recovered on day 60 of the follow-up. This case underscores the diagnostic complexity of coinfection and the use of NGS testing in this severe condition and the role of omadacycline in psittacosis .

papers.title_zh: 病例报告: 流感A型与鹦鹉热衣原体肺炎的合并感染
papers.source_body_en: The coinfection of influenza A and Chlamydia psittaci pneumoniae is rarely described in China. However, the clinical features of these diseases pose a significant diagnostic challenge. Therefore, it is necessary to report and review such a potentially fatal case. We report an 89-year-old male patient requiring admission to the intensive care unit with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, shock and MODS. He presented with fever, fatigue, anorexia and dyspnea. The patient exhibited severe hypoxemia, shock, hepatic dysfunction (elevated liver enzymes and serum bilirubin), acute kidney injury and a SOFA score of 17. Mechanical ventilation (MV) and venous-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) were established for respiratory support. The initial diagnosis focused on influenza A for his positive influenza A nucleic acid. However, the patient's imaging presentation was not coupled with viral pneumonia, which raised suspicion for other pathogens. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) detected coinfection of C psittaci , influenza A H3N2 virus, and Klebsiella pneumoniae in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid. Concurrent targeted NGS (tNGS) detected C. Omadacycline and baloxavir marboxil were prescribed. The patient's condition improved, and he was successfully weaned from VV-ECMO and MV. He was discharged and recovered on day 60 of the follow-up. This case underscores the diagnostic complexity of coinfection and the use of NGS testing in this severe condition and the role of omadacycline in psittacosis .
papers.abstract_zh: 流感A型与鹦鹉热衣原体肺炎的合并感染在中国鲜有报道。然而,这些疾病的临床特征给诊断带来了显著挑战。因此,有必要报告并回顾这样一个可能致命的病例。我们报告了一例89岁男性患者,因急性低氧性呼吸衰竭、休克和多器官功能障碍综合征(MODS)需要入住重症监护室。患者表现为发热、乏力、食欲减退和呼吸困难。患者出现严重低氧血症、休克、肝功能障碍(肝酶升高和血清胆红素升高)、急性肾损伤以及SOFA评分为17。为进行呼吸支持,建立了机械通气(MV)和静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合(VV-ECMO)。初始的诊断因其流感A型核酸阳性而聚焦于流感A型。然而,患者的影像学表现并未与病毒性肺炎相符,这引发了对其他病原体的怀疑。宏基因组下一代测序(mNGS)在支气管肺泡灌洗液中检测到鹦鹉热衣原体(C psittaci)、流感A型H3N2病毒和肺炎克雷伯菌的合并感染。同时进行的靶向下一代测序(tNGS)也检测到这些病原体。患者接受了奥马达西林和巴洛沙韦甲磺酸盐的治疗。患者病情好转,并成功脱离VV-ECMO和MV。在随访第60天时,患者出院并康复。该病例突显了合并感染的诊断复杂性,以及在严重情况下使用下一代测序(NGS)检测技术的重要性,同时强调了奥马达西林在鹦鹉热中的作用。

papers.title: Near real-time data on the human neutralizing antibody landscape to influenza virus in summer of 2026 shows antigenic advance of H3N2 subclade K region D mutants and H1N1 D.3.1.1 Sa mutants
papers.abstract: Abstract Human seasonal influenza evolves rapidly, necessitating twice yearly decisions about whether to update the strains in the vaccine. To help inform this decision, we have been using high-throughput sequencing-based neutralization assays to make twice yearly measurements of how recent human sera neutralize current human H3N2 and H1N1 strains. Here we provide the third installment in this series of measurements by reporting 47,851 titers representing neutralization of 148 viral strains by 325 human sera collected between April and August of 2026. Our measurements show that new H3N2 subclade K strains with mutations in antigenic region D and new H1N1 subclade D.3.1.1 strains with mutations in antigenic region Sa (such as G155E) have reduced neutralization by human sera, with notable heterogeneity in the impact of some of these mutations across sera from different individuals. This paper is accompanied by an interactive summary ( https://jbloomlab.github.io/flu-seqneut-2026/summary.html ) that enables detailed exploration of the results, and all titer data are publicly available for further analysis to aid vaccine antigen selection and studies of viral evolution.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Human seasonal influenza evolves rapidly, necessitating twice yearly decisions about whether to update the strains in the vaccine. Our measurements show that new H3N2 subclade K strains with mutations in antigenic region D and new H1N1 subclade D.3.1.1 strains with mutations in antigenic region Sa (such as G155E) have reduced neutralization by human sera, with notable heterogeneity in the impact of some of these mutations across sera from different individuals. This paper is accompanied by an interactive summary ( https://jbloomlab.github.io/flu-seqneut-2026/summary.html ) that enables detailed exploration of the results, and all titer data are publicly available for further analysis to aid vaccine antigen selection and studies of viral evolution.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人类季节性流感进化迅速,需要每年两次决定是否更新疫苗中的病毒株。为了帮助做出这一决策,我们使用基于高通量测序的中和试验,每年两次测量近期人类血清对当前人类H3N2和H1N1病毒株的中和能力。本文是这一系列测量的第三部分,报告了2026年4月至8月期间收集的325份人类血清对148种病毒株的中和滴度数据,共计47,851个滴度值。我们的测量结果显示,具有突变在抗原区域D中的新型H3N2亚型K病毒株和具有突变在抗原区域Sa(如G155E)中的新型H1N1亚型D.3.1.1病毒株的中和能力有所下降,且这些突变在不同个体的血清中表现出显著的异质性影响。本文附带一个交互式摘要(https://jbloomlab.github.io/flu-seqneut-2026/summary.html),可对结果进行详细探索,所有滴度数据均公开以供进一步分析,有助于疫苗抗原选择以及病毒进化的研究。

analysis_zh.methods: 为了帮助做出这一决策,我们使用基于高通量测序的中和试验,每年两次测量近期人类血清对当前人类H3N2和H1N1病毒株的中和能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本文是这一系列测量的第三部分,报告了2026年4月至8月期间收集的325份人类血清对148种病毒株的中和滴度数据,共计47,851个滴度值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本文附带一个交互式摘要(https://jbloomlab.github.io/flu-seqneut-2026/summary.html),可对结果进行详细探索,所有滴度数据均公开以供进一步分析,有助于疫苗抗原选择以及病毒进化的研究。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所提供的证据没有明确说明具体的科学或公共卫生含义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 我们的测量结果显示,具有突变在抗原区域D中的新型H3N2亚型K病毒株和具有突变在抗原区域Sa(如G155E)中的新型H1N1亚型D.3.1.1病毒株的中和能力有所下降,且这些突变在不同个体的血清中表现出显著的异质性影响。

media_mentions.content: Avian Flu Diary Covering Pandemic and Seasonal Flu, Emerging Infectious Diseases, public health, community & Individual preparedness. NOTE: All AFD blogs are written by a human - any mistakes are solely mine. Monday, September 21, 2026 Emerg. Microbes & Inf.: Novel emerging reassortant H6 avian influenza viruses with internal genes from G57 genotype of H9N2 pose potential zoonotic risk #19,342 A little over a year ago, in JOI: Prevalence and Transmission of Influenza A (H6) Viruses Pose a Potential Threat to Public Health, we revisited the H6 family of influenza A viruses, which are endemic in Asian poultry and are believed to have some degree of zoonotic potential. Long time readers will recall that H6N1 briefly made headlines in 2013 and 2014 after a college student in Taiwan was hospitalized with pneumonia (see Taiwan CDC: Epidemiological Analysis Of Human H6N1 Infection) and several dogs were found infected (see EID Journal: Influenza A(H6N1) In Dogs, Taiwan). But as an LPAI virus (and neither H5 or H7), it isn't considered a `reportable' disease in poultry or wild birds by WOAH, and therefore our knowledge of its spread and evolution is limited. That said, over the past decade we've seen growing interest by Chinese scientists in the spread and evolution of H6, particularly since it reassorts readily with another zoonotic risk: LPAI H9N2. A sampling of recent blogs include: J. Inf.: Zoonotic Threat of Novel H6N2 Avian Influenza Virus with Internal Genes Exclusively Derived from H9N2, China, 2025 Preprint: Progressive Adaptation of H6N1 Avian Influenza Virus in Taiwan Enhances Mammalian Infectivity, Pathogenicity and Transmissibility Study: Influenza A (H6N6) Viruses Isolated from Chickens Replicate in Mice and Human lungs Without Prior Adaptation H9N2 is a ubiquitous, and highly promiscuous avian influenza virus, which reassorts easily with other influenza A strains and has a record of lending its internal genes to more dangerous HA subtypes (see PNAS: Evolution Of H9N2 And It’s Effect On The Genesis Of H7N9). Today's study describes 6 H6 reassortants - all carrying the internal genes from H9N2 - and 5 with its NA from H5N1, and 1 from H9N2. Of note, the H6N2 isolate showed dual receptor binding to both avian and human-like receptor cells. The three representative isolates tested (NJ2501, AH25107, and CZ56) produced high virulence in mice, while all 6 produced respiratory symptoms in chickens, and transmitted efficiently among birds. Due to its length and technical nature, I've only posted some excerpts. Follow the link to read the report in its entirety. I'll have a postscript after you return. Novel emerging reassortant H6 avian influenza viruses with internal genes from G57 genotype of H9N2 pose potential zoonotic risk Zhimin Wana,b,c,d*, Wenjie Jianga,b,c,d*, Xudong Caoa,b,c,d, Xingyao Guoa,b,c,d, Xinyan Hea,b,c,d, Jianjun Zhange,Xinran Chua,b,c,d, Xinyi Jia,b,c,d, Yu Liua,b,c,d, Xuefeng Yina,b,c,d, Zhehong Zhaoa,b,c,d, Jixiang Wanga,b,c,d,Wei Gaoa,b,c,d, Quan Xiea,b,c,d, Tuofan Lia,b,c,d, Hongxia Shaoa,b,c, Aijian Qina,b,c, Yuhai Bif,g,h andJianqiang Yea,b,ca In recent decades, multiple novel reassortant avian influenza viruses (AIVs) carrying internal genes derived from H9N2 viruses have emerged in poultry in China and have repeatedly caused human infections, highlighting the pivotal role of the H9N2 internal genes cassette in facilitating cross-species transmission. In this study, five H6N1 and one H6N2 AIVs were isolated from chickens and Houdan chickens exhibiting respiratory symptoms. Genetic analyses revealed that the hemagglutinin (HA) genes of these H6 AIVs belonged to the ST339-like lineage and originated from H6 AIVs circulating in domestic geese in China, whereas the neuraminidase (NA) genes were derived from H9N2 or H5N1 AIVs, respectively. Notably, all six internal genes of these H6 isolates were derived from the G57 genotype H9N2 virus. In vitro studies demonstrated that these H6 AIVs replicated effectively in both avian and mammalian cells. The H6N2 isolate displayed dual receptor binding affinity for both avian-like and human-like receptors, whereas the five H6N1 viruses showed no detectable receptor binding affinity under the assay conditions in vitro. Reverse-genetics reassortant assay further revealed that the H6N1 HA itself possesses intrinsic dual receptor binding affinity. Furthermore, these H6 isolates exhibited high virulence in mice, and induced obvious respiratory symptoms in chickens, with efficient transmission among birds. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that H6 AIVs carrying the G57 H9N2 internal gene constellation are actively circulating in chicken populations and pose a substantial threat to poultry health, underscoring their potential risk to public health and the need for continued surveillance at the poultry-human interface. (SNIP) Discussion The continuous emergence of the novel reassortant AIVs poses a great threat to both poultry industry and public health. In this study, we identified and characterized six novel reassortant H6N1 and H6N2 AIVs circulating in chickens with respiratory symptoms, all of which harbour internal genes from the G57 genotype H9N2 virus. Our findings provide further evidence that H9N2 viruses serve as a critical genetic backbone facilitating the generation of novel reassortant AIVs with enhanced fitness in poultry and increase zoonotic potential. (SNIP) In addition to their mammalian pathogenicity, these H6 viruses demonstrated efficient infection and transmission in chickens. Viral shedding was detected in both infected and contact chickens (Figure 8), indicating effective direct-contact transmission of these novel H6 viruses. The ability to spread efficiently within poultry is a critical factor for viral maintenance and amplification, which increases the likelihood of further reassortment and spill-over events. Compared with previous reports in which H6 viruses showed limited transmission in poultry [26], the strains described here appear to have acquired enhanced transmissibility, possibly due to their adapted internal genes of H9N2 virus origin. (SNIP) In conclusion, our study highlights the evolution of H6 AIVs through reassortment with G57 genotype H9N2 viruses and demonstrates that such reassortment can result in AIVs with enhanced pathogenicity and cross-species transmission potential. These findings underscore the importance of continuous surveillance of AIVs in poultry flocks in China, particularly those carrying H9N2 internal genes, as they may serve as precursors to zoonotic or even pandemic AIVs. (Continue . . . ) While most people think first of `H5N1' when they hear about novel flu strains, the CDC's IRAT lists 27 avian, canine, or swine subtypes/variants with pandemic potential. Among the top 10 zoonotic influenza A viruses (ranked by likelihood of emergence) the CDC has placed H5N1 as 7th on the list, while H9N2 comes in at #5. And despite having caused documented human infections, a number of novel flu subtypes (e.g. H3N8, H5N5, H6N1, and H7N4) have yet to be added to this list. The reality is, most of these viruses will never pose a serious public health threat. But none of them can be ruled out as having pandemic potential. Which is why we follow their progress with considerable interest. Sunday, September 20, 2026 #NPM26: It's a 12 Volt Life CDC Infographic Note: This is the 20th day of National Preparedness Month. Follow this year’s campaign on Twitter by searching for the #NatlPrep #BeReady or #PrepMonth hashtags. This month, as part of NPM26, I’ll be rerunning some updated preparedness essays, along with some new ones. #19,341 Most disasters boil down to unscheduled camping - for days, or sometimes weeks - in your home, in a community shelter, or possibly even in your own backyard. Preparedness can not only make that process possible, it can make it far less miserable as well. But, as anyone who has ever tried to buy a loaf of bread or a gallon of milk after a hurricane or blizzard warning has been issued already knows, prepping has to be done well before a disaster looms. And quite frankly, given the rates of inflation and other global uncertainties, it seems likely that whatever you'd pay today for prep items will be higher in the future. And that assumes they will still be available. If you have unlimited funds, and plenty of room, you can prep in style. But most people are constrained by limited budgets, and other restraints, and so this list is primarily for them. Living in hurricane country, my biggest concerns revolve around prolonged power outages, which also can impact other utilities (including water, sewer, and internet). Following last 2024's one-two punch from Hurricanes Helene & Milton, I got my power back after only 4 days (although internet took a week). Before that, I went nearly a week without power following Irma in 2017, but many people had it far worse (most of Puerto Rico was without power for months after hurricane Maria in 2017). Not quite five years ago, in February of 2021, 3 successive winter storms swept across Texas, Louisiana, and Oklahoma, causing the worst collapse of the Texas energy grid on record (see Texas: The Latest - But Not The Last - Grid Down Crisis), resulting in hundreds of deaths (see City of Austin & Travis County 2021 WINTER STORM URI AFTER-ACTION REVIEW). And just last July, the U.S. Department of Energy published a 73-page report that warns that if current schedules for retirement of reliable power generation (especially baseload) continue, without enough firm replacement, the risk of blackouts in 2030 could increase by 100× over current levels. While those with tens of thousands of dollars to spend can have a whole-house solar system or generator - one capable of running freezers, refrigerators, and air conditioners - even a small budget system can make life without grid power a little more bearable. My minimum goal is to have enough sustainable power for lights, radio, phone charging, a personal MP3 player, and fans. Trying to run appliances, HVAC, or other high-draw devices is simply beyond my budget (but if you have enough money . . . . it can be done ). The following is an example of how one can put together a basic plug-and-play mini solar power system for around $100; one that will keep phones, lanterns, and some mini-fans charged and running for days. While I'm not recommending specific brands or suppliers, these photos are all typical of items I've purchased and used myself. This is my `bug out' solar kit; What I would grab if I had to abandon my home - and the bulk of my preps - in a hurry (note: I have 2 rechargeable USB batteries and an MP3 player). It all fits in a tiny duffle bag that weighs less than 5lbs. For a bit more money you could go for a slightly bigger solar panel, additional USB battery banks, and maybe a personal MP3 player, walkie-talkies, and an emergency radio. As the following photo illustrates, this type of modular system can be expanded over time. The biggest downside to these types of setups is you are limited to USB (typically 5 volt) appliances. Fine for flashlights, phones, and MP3 players, but not nearly as versatile as a 12 volt system. For 12v/110v power, you could opt to buy a Jackery, Bluetti, EcoFlow, or similar `Solar Battery' setup, but it would set you back $400 -$1000+ (plus solar panel). And if it breaks, you don't have many options beyond sending it back for repair. However, if you build your own - and keep a few spare parts on hand - you should be able to to keep it running yourself. (note: If you aren't comfortable working with these types of components, get help from someone who is). In 2024 I described building a rudimentary LiFePo4 power station (see picture below), which packed a decent 600 Watt/hour capacity. LiFePo4 batteries are lighter than lead/acid, are far less dangerous, and can be charged and discharged (fully) thousands of times. My system featured dual 12V Car Cigarette Lighter Sockets (for CPAP, Electric cooler/fridge, or Inverter), 2 USB outlets, and I added a small 110v inverter. It is recharged by a 100 watt solar panel (shown on left). After my last hurricane I endeavored to improve my 12-volt battery bank (for build details, see Post-Milton Improvements To My Power Preps) Weighing in at less than 15 lbs, this 50 amp/hr (600 watt/hour) setup is self contained, with storage for cables, a wall charger, and a small 110v inverter. All you need to add is a solar panel (100 watt or better). The plastic carrying case was $12 at Harbor Freight, the 50 amp/hr battery was $109 on Amazon, and the rest of the build (solar charge controller, cables, lighted output panel, inverter) added about $60. All in, including taxes, this can be assembled in a couple of hours for less than $200. I built a second, lighter weight and smaller version using a 20 amp/hr LiFePo4 battery (240 watt/hours) for less than $140. Something to keep on the bedside table. Whether home built, or store bought, these `solar generators' can greatly expand what you can do during a prolonged blackout. They can recharge any USB item, run most 12 volt appliances, and some can power small 110 volt appliances for a short period of time. Even without the 110 volt output, which on small systems provides limited value, these setups can power a lot of useful items. Two years ago I purchased some very nice 4-packs of LED lanterns, and some USB battery powered water pumps that attach as a faucet to large water jugs. Just three days after they arrived I endured a 3-day water outage at home, and found the faucets actually worked pretty well. Every home should have a battery operated radio (with NWS weather band), yet many do not. Some are available with crank or solar charging, but most have rechargeable batteries via a USB port. A 12 volt system (of sufficient size) can power a mini-fridge, or electric cooler, and can not only keep food from spoiling, and drinks cold, it can keep medications like insulin cool. As for entertainment - which should not be discounted during a prolonged power outage - while a USB setup will power and charge a personal MP3 player, a 12 volt system can run a DVD player. As an aside - I've collected (public domain) OTR (Old Time Radio) shows since the early 1990s, and have literally thousands of hours stored on CDs in MP3 format. The Internet Archive has a huge repository where you can download them for free, along with thousands of audiobooks. I keep a couple of MP3 players filled with these shows and with audiobooks in my bug-out bag. When the power and internet were down, they have provided me with hours of entertainment. Over the years I've bought several cheap MP3 players ($20-$30) and filled them with thousands of hours of these shows (mostly from the 1940s and 1950s), giving them as gifts. And the nice thing is, you don't have to wait for an emergency to enjoy them. Admittedly, since I lived happily for nearly 15 years aboard boats (2 sailboats, 1 power boat) here in Florida - where 12 volts ran just about everything - I may be a bit more amenable to the 12 volt life than others. But despite its obvious limitations, it sure beats cursing the darkness. Saturday, September 19, 2026 EID Journal: Detection of HPAI A(H5N1) Virus in Cat and Rats during Outbreak in Backyard Poultry, United States, 2025 #19,340 Today we've a dispatch, published yesterday in the CDC's EID Journal, which describes the findings of HPAI H5N1 in a cat and a rat from an Illinois farm which experienced a bird flu outbreak in March of 2025. While it is not exactly `news' that both species are susceptible to H5N1 infection (see below), our understanding of how HPAI may spread among peridomestic animals on farms remains limited.
